title: Boasting beside the kitchen stove
odia:
ଚୂଲିମୂଳେ ନହୁଣିଆ ପାରୁଥିବ ବିଲେଇ...
ପୁଅ ଦେଖଉଚି ନୁଖୁରା ବଡ଼େଇ...!!
literal_meaning: The cat may be doing nahunia exercises beside the stove; the boy displays empty boasting.
explanation: The source introduces this line for unnecessary swagger. A cat’s ordinary-looking movement by the stove is set beside a boy making much of himself. The disproportion makes the boast look small: loud self-display is not itself an achievement.
meaning_odia: ଚୁଲି ପାଖରେ ବିଲେଇ ନହୁଣିଆ ପାରୁଛି, ଆଉ ପୁଅ ବଡ଼େଇ ଦେଖାଉଛି—ଏହି ତୁଳନାରେ ଅଯଥା ଆସ୍ଫାଳନକୁ ଛୋଟ କରିଦିଆଯାଇଛି। ଉତ୍ସରେ ବି ଅଯଥା ଆସ୍ଫାଳନ କରୁଥିବା ଲୋକ ପାଇଁ ଉକ୍ତିଟି ଦିଆଯାଇଛି। କଥାର ଜୋର ଦେଖାଇବା ଓ ସତରେ କିଛି କରିବା ଏକ କଥା ନୁହେଁ।
usage_example: Someone claims to be an expert after one easy practice task, and a friend gently punctures the swagger. (Original imagined occasion.)
cultural_context: The dictionary lists nahunia as a kind of bodily exercise, which supports retaining an exercise image; no precise pose or movement sequence is established. The source’s own usage condition supports the swagger reading. The literal rendering of ନୁଖୁରା as empty remains contextual rather than separately dictionary-certified.
odia_summary: ବିଲେଇର ଚୁଲିପାଖ ଚଳନ ସହ ପୁଅର ବଡ଼େଇକୁ ମିଳାଇ ଅଯଥା ଆସ୍ଫାଳନକୁ ପରିହାସ କରାଯାଇଛି।
english_summary: A kitchen-side cat gives a comic counter-image to someone’s exaggerated swagger.
